title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack Lead Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack Lead Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Lead Developer to join our growing engineering team. This role combines hands-on senior development with day-to-day team leadership, working closely with the CTO. You will design and build software while also manage day-to-day engineering operations - including ticket creation and assignment, PR oversight, and team processes.


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is technically strong and has prior experience in a lead role - someone who enjoys writing production code, mentoring a talented senior team, and helping coordinate the day-to-day workflow so the CTO can focus on higher-level direction.


You will work across application code and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with the CTO to deliver scalable, reliable systems and keep a high-performing team running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities


Team Leadership & Engineering Operations

• Work closely with the CTO to manage day-to-day engineering workload and ensure the team stays productive and unblocked

• Own ticket creation, triage, and assignment, keeping the backlog healthy and priorities clear

• Oversee pull request processes, ensuring code quality standards are upheld and reviews are timely

• Maintain and improve engineering processes and standards across a predominantly senior team

• Ensure strong database practices are followed across the team, including schema design, query efficiency, and data integrity

• Serve as a technical point of contact for escalations, cross-team coordination, and architectural decisions


Software Development & Feature Delivery

• Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services using C# and .NET

• Build application features that interact deeply with the database, balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability

• Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems

• Participate in architectural discussions and influence technical direction across the stack

• Perform code reviews and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers


Azure Cloud & DevOps

• Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure, with a focus on reliability and observability

• Support CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices using Azure DevOps

• Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution

• Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost


Required Qualifications


Experience & Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience

• 7+ years of professional experience in C#/.NET software development

• Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency)


Technical Skills (Priority Order)

• Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework

• Proven experience in a lead or senior lead developer role, assisting engineering management with day-to-day team operations

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL knowledge from a developer perspective
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs

• Experience with Microsoft Azure services, including App Services, Storage, and Azure SQL Database

• Experience integrating with third-party APIs

• CRM system experience and familiarity with common CRM integration patterns

• Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)

• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies

• Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps


Soft Skills

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical stakeholders

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems

• High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability

• Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams


Bonus Qualifications

• Experience with communications platforms and APIs such as Twilio, Vonage, Plivo, or similar for SMS, voice, and messaging workflows

• Familiarity with real-time communications protocols: VoIP, WebRTC, and SIP

• Experience with open-source telephony platforms such as Asterisk or FreeSWITCH

• Experience with message-based systems (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.)

• Strong understanding of DevOps practices and production operations

• Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments


What We Offer

• Competitive salary commensurate with experience

• Opportunity to own critical systems and influence architectural decisions

• A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Professor de inglês online
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês online em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A DevSpeak Academy é uma escola especializada no ensino de inglês para profissionais da área de tecnologia. Nosso foco é preparar alunos para se comunicarem com confiança no mercado internacional, em turmas pequenas e com aulas totalmente online.

Estamos em busca de professores(as) de inglês para integrar nosso time! Procuramos profissionais engajados, comunicativos e que saibam se conectar com adultos que trabalham em TI, trazendo para as aulas situações práticas e relevantes para o dia a dia desses alunos.


Responsabilidades

  • Preparar e ministrar aulas online para adultos, focando em fluência e comunicação em contextos profissionais.
  • Personalizar o conteúdo conforme as necessidades dos alunos, com foco em temas ligados à área de tecnologia.
  • Preencher e manter atualizadas as planilhas de presença e conteúdos ministrados.
  • Disponibilizar semanalmente os materiais e gravações no Google Classroom, seguindo a metodologia da escola.
  • Incentivar a participação e engajamento dos alunos, criando um ambiente colaborativo e motivador.
  • Participar de treinamentos e reuniões pedagógicas para melhoria contínua.


Requisitos

  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.
  • Experiência como professor(a) de inglês.
  • Disponibilidade no período da noite (18h–22h), duas vezes por semana (segunda/quarta ou terça/quinta).
  • Perfil comunicativo e afinidade para trabalhar com profissionais da área de TI.
  • Organização e comprometimento com prazos.
  • Possuir computador para ministrar as aulas.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Disponibilidade no período da manhã (7h-9h), duas vezes por semana (segunda/quarta ou terça/quinta).
  • Conhecimento em Google Meet e Google Classroom.
  • Experiência com ensino para profissionais de TI.
  • Certificações em ensino de inglês (TEFL, CELTA ou equivalentes).


Contratação

  • Regime PJ .
  • Horários fixos (aulas no início da manhã e/ou à noite), com flexibilidade para conciliar com a disponibilidade do professor.
  • Turmas pequenas, que permitem um acompanhamento próximo e personalizado.


Se você tem paixão por ensinar e quer fazer parte de uma escola que conecta inglês e tecnologia, envie seu CV.

  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs

• Experience integrating with third-party APIs

• CRM system experience and familiarity with common CRM integration patterns

• Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)

• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies

• Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps


Soft Skills

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical stakeholders

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems

• High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability

• Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams


Bonus Qualifications

• Experience with communications platforms and APIs such as Twilio, Vonage, Plivo, or similar for SMS, voice, and messaging workflows

• Familiarity with real-time communications protocols: VoIP, WebRTC, and SIP

• Experience with open-source telephony platforms such as Asterisk or FreeSWITCH

• Experience with message-based systems (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.)

• Strong understanding of DevOps practices and production operations

• Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments


What We Offer

• Competitive salary commensurate with experience

• Opportunity to own critical systems and influence architectural decisions

title: Professor de inglês online
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês online em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A DevSpeak Academy é uma escola especializada no ensino de inglês para profissionais da área de tecnologia. Nosso foco é preparar alunos para se comunicarem com confiança no mercado internacional, em turmas pequenas e com aulas totalmente online.

Estamos em busca de professores(as) de inglês para integrar nosso time! Procuramos profissionais engajados, comunicativos e que saibam se conectar com adultos que trabalham em TI, trazendo para as aulas situações práticas e relevantes para o dia a dia desses alunos.

  • Preparar e ministrar aulas online para adultos, focando em fluência e comunicação em contextos profissionais.

  • Disponibilizar semanalmente os materiais e gravações no Google Classroom, seguindo a metodologia da escola.

  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.
  • Experiência como professor(a) de inglês.
  • Disponibilidade no período da noite (18h–22h), duas vezes por semana (segunda/quarta ou terça/quinta).

  • Organização e comprometimento com prazos.
  • Possuir computador para ministrar as aulas.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Disponibilidade no período da manhã (7h-9h), duas vezes por semana (segunda/quarta ou terça/quinta).

Contratação

  • Horários fixos (aulas no início da manhã e/ou à noite), com flexibilidade para conciliar com a disponibilidade do professor.

  • Backend Mastery: Strong experience with C#.NET, MVC, SQL databases , and ORM frameworks (e.g., Entity Framework).

  • 7+ Years Experience: Minimum 7+ years in software development, with a preference for client-facing or agency environments .

  • Communication: Exceptional oral and written communication skills; able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

﻿

\"As a Professional Services Developer, you aren't just building a product; you are building a solution. You have the unique opportunity to see the immediate impact of your work on a client's business operations, making you a vital part of the customer's success story.\"

title: SDET Coordinator - Disaster Recovery
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SDET Coordinator - Disaster Recovery em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

Today, we are proudly recognized as one of the largest staffing augmentation companies in the United States by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). We are also a Minority-Owned Company, and we take pride in our strong commitment to diversity.

In Brazil, we have been operating since 2007 and have successfully partnered with more than 50 clients from different sectors of the economy.


What to Expect From Us

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.


About the Client

This position will support one of our clients that is a leading healthcare company in the United States, focused on technology, operational resilience, and large-scale enterprise


Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and coordinate disaster recovery (DR) testing activities across enterprise applications and services
  • Develop and execute structured DR test scenarios aligned with predefined recovery patterns
  • Produce detailed post-test reports, including outcomes, gaps, and recommendations for improvement
  • Track the build-out process of applications and services adhering to established DR strategies
  • Capture and manage corrective action plan (CAP) items in tools such as Fusion or ServiceNow
  • Support the adoption of automated and continuous testing practices for production systems
  • Maintain and manage scheduled (cadenced) DR testing cycles to ensure ongoing readiness
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on testing efficiency and DR process enhancements
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional DR team members and stakeholders
  • Facilitate coordination and execution of DR exercises to reduce risk and improve resilience
  • Support additional DR-related activities and initiatives as assigned by leadership


Required Qualifications

  • Experience in Disaster Recovery, IT resilience, or testing and validation processes
  • Strong understanding of disaster recovery concepts such as RTO, RPO, failover, and service restoration
  • Experience coordinating and executing testing activities in enterprise IT environments
  • Familiarity with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow for tracking incidents and action items
  • Ability to analyze test results and produce clear, actionable reports
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple testing cycles and priorities
  • Experience working in cross-functional teams with effective collaboration skills
  • Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal)
  • Problem-solving mindset with focus on risk reduction and process improvement


Additional Information

• 100% Remote position - Brazil

• Long-term / indefinite project

• International team environment

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

  • Cost and capacity management in Azure 
  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  
  • Prior team lead experience

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Closer

Descrição da vaga


Como Closer na Nutri de Consultório, você será responsável por conduzir as conversas finais com nutricionistas que já demonstraram interesse na Aceleração Nutri de Consultório (ANC), nosso treinamento principal para nutricionistas que querem estruturar e escalar seus consultórios. title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

Job Title: AI Visual Storytelling Designer/AI Creative Producer


About the Role

Our client company (a US-based Creative Agency) is looking for 2–3 highly creative AI-native talents who can combine generative AI, motion design, video editing, and visual storytelling to create modern, high-performing social content for brands and ventures.


This is not a traditional graphic design or video editing role. We are looking for creatives who deeply understand internet aesthetics, AI-powered workflows, cinematic social visuals, and short-form content that captures attention immediately.


You will work across AI-generated imagery, motion graphics, editing, creative direction, and experimental visual concepts to produce premium content similar to the examples below:

  • AI-generated cinematic visuals
  • Social-first brand content
  • Stylized motion design
  • Creative AI advertising assets
  • Premium/High-end startup and venture-style aesthetics

  • Create visually compelling AI-powered social content for Instagram and paid ads
  • Produce short-form videos using AI-generated visuals, motion graphics, editing, and sound design

  • Edit high-quality content with strong pacing, transitions, typography, and cinematic composition
  • Stay up to date with AI creative trends, social content trends, and emerging tools
  • Maintain strong brand aesthetics and visual consistency across projects
  • Iterate quickly and efficiently in a fast-paced startup environment


Ideal Candidate

  • Strong portfolio showcasing AI-generated visuals, motion graphics, or cinematic social content

  • Strong understanding of visual storytelling, pacing, composition, typography, and internet culture
  • Ability to combine creativity with execution speed
  • Self-directed, proactive, and highly collaborative
  • Strong aesthetic taste and attention to detail
  • Comfortable experimenting with new creative workflows and AI tools

Experience with several of the following:

  • Runway

  • CapCut

  • Sora

  • Motion graphics and animation
  • Short-form content editing
  • Creative direction
  • Storyboarding and concept development
  • Sound design and pacing
  • Brand storytelling


Nice to Have

  • Understanding of viral short-form content frameworks
  • Experience with 3D or experimental visual workflows
  • Familiarity with creative automation workflows

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879 em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

  • Reportar os feedbacks e objeções recorrentes dos leads para alimentar marketing e produto
  • Acompanhar as suas métricas de desempenho e buscar evolução contínua


Competências

  • Experiência prévia comprovada como Closer ou em vendas consultivas de ticket alto (a partir de R$ 3.000)
  • Domínio de técnicas de fechamento consultivo (SPIN Selling, quebra de objeções, ancoragem de valor, criação de urgência ética)
  • Excelente comunicação verbal (calls) e escrita (follow-ups por WhatsApp e e-mail)
  • Inteligência emocional e resiliência para lidar com objeções e \"nãos\" sem desgaste
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas claras e ciclo de venda mais longo
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CRM e gestão de pipeline
  • Postura consultiva — você ouve antes de falar, entende antes de oferecer
  • Diferencial: conhecimento ou interesse pelo mercado de nutrição ou educação.


Valores da Empresa

Os valores da empresa regem todos os atos de cada pessoa que faz parte da nossa equipe:

- Excelência na entrega

- Aprimoramento constante

- Foco na necessidade dos clientes

- Transparência


Localização: trabalho remoto.


Tipo de contrato: PJ

Se você gosta de vender, tem habilidades em vendas de ticket alto e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que está revolucionando a nutrição no Brasil, este é o seu lugar!


Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir reuniões de venda consultiva por vídeo/call com leads qualificados pelo time de SDR
  • Realizar diagnósticos aprofundados das dores, objetivos e contexto de cada candidata antes de apresentar a ANC
  • Apresentar a ANC de forma personalizada, conectando os módulos do treinamento às necessidades reais do lead
  • Identificar, antecipar e quebrar objeções com técnica e empatia (preço, tempo, momento profissional, dúvidas familiares)
  • Conduzir follow-ups estruturados e estratégicos até o fechamento da venda
  • Negociar condições de pagamento dentro das condições definidas pela empresa
  • Manter o CRM atualizado com status do lead, próximos passos, gravações e insights de cada conversa
  • Bater meta mensal de receita
  • Reportar os feedbacks e objeções recorrentes dos leads para alimentar marketing e produto
  • Acompanhar as suas métricas de desempenho e buscar evolução contínua


Competências

  • Experiência prévia comprovada como Closer ou em vendas consultivas de ticket alto (a partir de R$ 3.000)
  • Domínio de técnicas de fechamento consultivo (SPIN Selling, quebra de objeções, ancoragem de valor, criação de urgência ética)
  • Excelente comunicação verbal (calls) e escrita (follow-ups por WhatsApp e e-mail)
  • Inteligência emocional e resiliência para lidar com objeções e \"nãos\" sem desgaste
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas claras e ciclo de venda mais longo
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CRM e gestão de pipeline
  • Postura consultiva — você ouve antes de falar, entende antes de oferecer

Valores da Empresa

Os valores da empresa regem todos os atos de cada pessoa que faz parte da nossa equipe:

- Excelência na entrega

- Aprimoramento constante

- Foco na necessidade dos clientes

- Transparência

Tipo de contrato: PJ

description:

A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa referência em soluções de dados e analytics na busca por um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Dados .


Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na condução de iniciativas end-to-end — desde a fase de discovery até o go-live — atuando como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio. O desafio envolve liderar projetos complexos de dados, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, dentro do prazo e alinhadas aos objetivos da organização.


Buscamos um perfil que una forte experiência em gestão de projetos com repertório técnico em dados, capaz de navegar com autonomia entre stakeholders, engenharia e decisões de arquitetura.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos de dados de média e alta complexidade (data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, BI, migração de dados, entre outros).
  • Definir e gerenciar escopo, cronograma, orçamento, recursos e riscos.
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (dailies, sprints, retrospectivas) e adaptar frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, híbrido) conforme o contexto.
  • Atuar como interface entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, traduzindo demandas em planos de execução claros.
  • Monitorar KPIs de projeto (velocity, burn-down, progresso) e comunicar status para diferentes níveis da organização.
  • Antecipar riscos, dependências e gargalos, propondo planos de mitigação.
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros envolvidos nas entregas.
  • Garantir documentação estruturada de processos, decisões e aprendizados.
  • Impulsionar melhoria contínua nas práticas de gestão de projetos da área de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (5+ anos) em gestão de projetos de tecnologia, sendo ao menos 2 anos em projetos de dados ou analytics.
  • Conhecimento prático do ecossistema de dados: data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, modelagem de dados e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau ou similares).
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK/Waterfall), com flexibilidade de aplicação.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday, Asana ou similares).
  • Forte habilidade de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação executiva.
  • Capacidade de interpretar documentação técnica (arquitetura, modelos de dados, integrações).
  • Inglês fluente (interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais).


Diferenciais

  • Background técnico prévio (Data Analyst, Data Engineer ou BI Developer).
  • Experiência com cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
  • Uso de soluções de IA como aceleradores de entrega.
  • Conhecimento em SQL para validações básicas.
  • Vivência com change management em contextos data-driven.
  • Conhecimento em governança de dados (ex: DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Certificações (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM, SAFe ou similares).
  • Experiência com gestão de portfólio e priorização estratégica.

description:

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Vendas Sênior com experiência relevante na indústria de componentes eletrônicos para integrar a equipe da Win Source. O candidato ideal será responsável por desenvolver contas, realizar o acompanhamento de consultas e manter relacionamentos de longo prazo. Esta posição é fundamental para aprimorar o desempenho de vendas da empresa e a satisfação do cliente.


Sobre a Win Source:


A Win Source é uma distribuidora líder de componentes eletrônicos, comprometida em oferecer serviços de excelência e soluções inovadoras para clientes em todo o mundo. Nossa missão é apoiar o avanço tecnológico de nossos clientes, garantindo a disponibilidade de componentes de alta qualidade.


Site da empresa: win-source.net


Conteúdo do Trabalho: (Jornada de trabalho de 5 dias, 8 horas diárias)

1. Desenvolver clientes, realizar acompanhamento (follow-up), identificar e classificar consultas de clientes, e executar a manutenção contínua desses contatos.

2. Elaborar cotações para produtos solicitados pelos clientes, acompanhar a demanda dos clientes por produtos, conduzir negociações comerciais, concluir pedidos e monitorar a entrega dos produtos para garantir a qualidade, quantidade, prazo de entrega e modalidade de transporte, conforme os requisitos do cliente.

3. Desenvolver estrategicamente seu território de vendas por meio da aquisição planejada e sistemática de novos clientes, mantendo comunicação e coordenação constantes com os departamentos internos de atendimento e técnico.

4. Manter regularmente um bom serviço de pós-venda e bons relacionamentos com os clientes, via e-mail e telefone, preservando parcerias de cooperação de longo prazo.

5. Motivar e liderar a equipe de vendas, definir objetivos claros, monitorar a evolução do desempenho e fornecer os treinamentos e recursos necessários.

6. Realizar viagens de negócios locais para visitar clientes e participar de diversas feiras e exposições do setor.


Perspectivas de Carreira:

Engenheiro de Vendas Sênior → Líder de Equipe Comercial → Gerente Regional → Diretor de Vendas


Sistema Remuneratório:

Salário base + Comissão + Bônus por Desempenho + Bônus por Projetos + Bônus de Final de Ano


Requisitos para a Vaga:

1. Disponibilidade para atuar em escritórios nacionais em diversas partes do mundo.

Os países com vagas abertas incluem: Estados Unidos, Japão, Reino Unido, Canadá, Alemanha, Itália, Austrália, Dinamarca, Espanha, França, Coreia do Sul, Brasil e Malásia. (É exigido residir e trabalhar localmente, além de possuir planos de desenvolvimento de longo prazo na região).

2. Possuir conhecimento específico sobre componentes eletrônicos ou sobre a indústria eletrônica, compreendendo as tendências de mercado e as necessidades dos clientes.

3. Experiência na indústria de distribuição de componentes eletrônicos é um diferencial.


Benefícios:

1. Desfrutar de feriados nacionais oficiais e benefícios festivos. 2. Os funcionários efetivos terão direito a gratificações por tempo de serviço, férias anuais remuneradas (de até 10 dias) e licença-maternidade remunerada.

3. A empresa organiza viagens anualmente e promove outras atividades periodicamente.

4. Convidamos regularmente profissionais de destaque do setor para treinamentos e aprendizado, além de realizarmos sessões de compartilhamento de experiências de negócios.

5. A empresa participa regularmente de feiras internacionais de eletrônicos todos os anos (nos Estados Unidos, Alemanha, Vietnã e Brasil).

6. Oferecemos treinamento remunerado abrangente, incluindo capacitação inicial sobre produtos, métodos comerciais e raciocínio estratégico, organizado em etapas para garantir uma formação sistemática, com orientação individual personalizada (mentoria 1 a 1).

7. O período de experiência inclui o recebimento de comissões, e há dois dias de folga aos finais de semana.


Requisitos e Habilidades:

1. Graduação (nível superior) ou formação acadêmica superior; a área de formação é flexível (preferência para cursos em Engenharia Eletrônica ou Marketing).

2. Boas habilidades de escuta, fala, leitura e escrita; proficiência no uso do idioma inglês para comunicação e negociação com clientes.

3. Boas habilidades de comunicação, coordenação e execução; capacidade de resposta rápida e perspicaz; forte senso de responsabilidade.

4. Experiência em técnicas e estratégias de vendas, incluindo habilidades de apresentação e negociação.

5. Forte capacidade de aprendizado e espírito de busca por aprendizado contínuo.

6. Aspiração em atuar e paixão pelo setor de comércio exterior e e-commerce.

7. Bom espírito de equipe.

title: AI Benchmark Engineer (Reasoning/Math) - 75046
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Benchmark Engineer (Reasoning/Math) - 75046 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly analytical and computationally proficient individual to join our team with a strong research background. You will be instrumental in contributing to this role by either crafting challenging and insightful problems in your respective research domain, devising elegant computational solutions.


Responsibilities:

  • Build multi-agent benchmark tasks that require multi-step mathematical reasoning, proof construction, or algorithmic problem-solving
  • Design problems that are genuinely hard for a single agent but decomposable — competition math, numerical analysis, combinatorial optimization, statistical inference
  • Create verification scripts that check mathematical correctness — numerical answers with appropriate tolerance, proof step validity, algorithm output correctness
  • Write clear problem statements with precise notation, definitions, and output format
  • Create decomposition guides that split problems into independent sub-computations or parallel solution strategies


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in mathematics, quantitative research, or computational science (e.g., competition math, university-level mathematics, or quantitative research)
  • Strong Python programming skills, including NumPy, SciPy, or symbolic computation (SymPy)
  • Experience writing mathematical proofs or formal derivations
  • Ability to create problems with precise, verifiable answers (not subjective or open-ended)
  • Familiarity with AI coding benchmarks such as SWE-bench and Terminal-bench
  • Comfortable with Docker (writing Dockerfiles, building images, debugging containers)
  • Understanding of numerical methods, including floating-point tolerance, convergence criteria, and error bounds


Nice to have:

  • Experience creating math competition problems (e.g., AMC, AIME, Putnam, IMO, or similar)
  • Research experience in mathematics, theoretical computer science, or quantitative fields
  • Experience with automated theorem proving or formal verification
  • Knowledge of AI reasoning benchmarks (e.g., GSM8K, MATH, AIME, GPQA, ARC-AGI)
  • Experience with large-scale numerical computation or scientific computing


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments required: 40 hours /week with 4 hours of PST Overlap
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 1 month; (expected start date is next week)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Retention Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?


About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.


What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

title: System Engineer

*Please Read*

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis.


Sobre nós:  Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades.


Visão geral da posição

  • Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos.
  • Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula.
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos.
  • Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas.
  • Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas.
  • Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.


Formato

  • Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI)
  • Local : Remoto
  • Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda


Requisitos

  • Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1)
  • Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula.
  • Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo).
  • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online.
  • CNPJ / MEI ativo.


Por que se juntar à nós?

  • Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem.
  • Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino.
  • Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

title: Remote Computer Science Expert - 79004
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Computer Science Expert - 79004 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Job Overview:

We are looking for PhD-level computer science experts to help fine-tune and evaluate large language models, including systems similar to ChatGPT. The role focuses on designing challenging, conceptual computer science problems that test advanced AI reasoning across topics such as algorithms, systems design, cybersecurity, theory, databases, networks, and other undergraduate to PhD-level computer science domains.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design advanced computer science problems that test AI model performance across conceptual and reasoning-heavy topics, including systems design, algorithms, cybersecurity, and other advanced CS areas.
  • Develop clear, step-by-step reference solutions with rigorous logic, well-structured explanations, and defensible reasoning.
  • Evaluate AI-generated responses for correctness, reasoning quality, completeness, clarity, and alignment with the intended problem requirements.
  • Identify flaws, gaps, edge cases, and near-miss reasoning patterns in AI outputs.
  • Collaborate with researchers to refine benchmarks across undergraduate, graduate, and PhD-level computer science topics.
  • Provide structured feedback to improve problem quality, benchmark reliability, and model evaluation standards.


Required Qualifications:

  • PhD, completed or pursuing, in Computer Science or a closely related field.
  • Strong computer science reasoning and problem-solving skills across advanced domains.
  • Ability to design challenging conceptual problems that require deep understanding rather than straightforward recall or coding.
  • Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas clearly and logically.
  • Strong attention to detail in evaluating reasoning, assumptions, definitions, edge cases, and solution validity.
  • Ability to provide structured, high-quality feedback on AI-generated responses.
  • No prior AI experience required.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior AI Software Engineer (LLM & Agent Systems)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior AI Software Engineer (LLM & Agent Systems) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Overview

Our client is a fast-growing technology company building modern, data-driven products with a strong focus on leveraging AI to create scalable systems and internal efficiencies. Their team is focused on moving fast, shipping high-quality solutions, and using the latest advancements in AI to multiply engineering output across the organization.


They are particularly focused on applying AI not as a feature, but as a core layer of how work gets done —automating workflows, enhancing product capabilities, and enabling small teams to achieve outsized impact.


Role Overview

We are looking for a full-time (40 hours/week) Senior AI Systems Engineer who operates natively with AI tools and builds production-ready systems using agents and LLM workflows.

This role requires someone who has gone beyond basic AI usage and can design and deploy systems that automate work, integrate tools, and significantly increase engineering productivity .

You will work in the EST time zone , collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities where AI can replace manual processes and unlock efficiency.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build and deploy AI agents for internal and user-facing workflows
  • Design systems that retrieve, process, and act on data autonomously
  • Integrate APIs, tools, and data sources into AI-driven workflows
  • Use tools like Claude/Codex to accelerate development and output
  • Identify and implement AI-driven automation opportunities across teams

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are looking for AI Benchmark Engineers specializing in planning and operations to design and build complex, multi-agent benchmark tasks that simulate real-world planning, scheduling, and operational decision-making scenarios. This role focuses on creating constraint-rich problems that evaluate multi-agent reasoning, decomposition, and optimization capabilities in realistic environments.


What does day-to-day life look like?

Design and develop multi-agent benchmark tasks involving:

  • Planning, scheduling, and resource allocation
  • Operational decision-making (project management, logistics, incident response, capacity planning)
  • Create constraint-rich problem statements with multiple interacting variables

Develop verification scripts to evaluate:

  • Feasibility (all constraints satisfied)
  • Completeness (all requirements addressed)
  • Optimality (efficient solutions)

Build decomposition strategies:

  • Split tasks across specialized sub-agents (resource-based, constraint-based, conflict resolution, optimization)
  • Model real-world operational scenarios with dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints
  • Collaborate on improving task quality, coverage, and evaluation rigor


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in operations, project management, logistics, or supply chain
  • Strong ability to formalize constraints, dependencies, and scheduling logic
  • Proficiency in Python for building verification and validation scripts
  • Strong structured problem-solving and decomposition skills
  • Clear and precise technical writing skills
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-bench)
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (Dockerfiles, image builds, debugging)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with optimization techniques (linear programming, constraint satisfaction, scheduling algorithms)
  • Background in operations research

  • Knowledge of AI planning systems or automated reasoning
  • Project management experience or certifications (PMP, Agile, etc.)

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Freelance Instructor - HashiCorp em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Freelance HashiCorp Trainers : Terraform and Vault (Remote)


Company Description

LearnQuest is a trusted global training provider with over 20 years of experience in delivering tailored technology education solutions to leading companies, organizations, and government agencies. Specializing in designing and developing comprehensive training programs, LearnQuest enables clients to access training when, where, and how it is most effective for their needs.

LearnQuest is a global training partner of IBM. With HashiCorp now part of the IBM family, we are expanding our instructor pool to support upcoming HashiCorp training initiatives across the globe.

Role Description

We are looking for experienced freelance instructors to deliver authorized HashiCorp Vault and/or Terraform training for our global clients. Selected candidates will be onboarded as freelance instructors.


What We're Looking For

For HashiCorp Vault:

• Proven experience delivering Vault training along with hands-on expertise.

• Active and latest version of HashiCorp Vault Associate Certification (mandatory prerequisite)


For HashiCorp Terraform:

• Proven experience delivering Terraform training along with hands on experience.

• Active and latest version of HashiCorp Terraform Associate Certification (mandatory pre requisite)


What Next?

We will then shortlist most suitable candidate for enabling the trainer to become HashiCorp Authorized Instructor for Vault/Terraform.



Key responsibilities:

• Deliver instructor-led HashiCorp Vault and/or Terraform trainings for corporate clients

• Engage with LearnQuest's global client base as a freelance instructor


How to Apply and who must apply for this posting?

If this opportunity matches what we are looking for and if this interests you, please send your updated profile/ CV along with:

• Your experience delivering HashiCorp Vault/Terraform trainings and work experience around it

• Relevant certifications of vault associate/Terraform associate

• Your Credly profile link


Language capability: Since we are looking for instructors globally, we are looking at enabling instructors who can deliver trainings in different languages including English, Portuguese, Italian and other foreign languages.


Send your application to:


Location: Can be virtual and at times face to face training based on client’s demand.


Important Note: Please direct all your responses to only. Any queries sent on LinkedIn may not receive response.

title: Small Business Owner (AI evaluation) - 78324
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Small Business Owner (AI evaluation) - 78324 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

Evaluate and compare the quality of responses from multiple AI chatbots across real-world small business use cases.


Responsibilities:

  • Create realistic business-related prompts based on defined user goals
  • Interact with multiple AI chatbots (max. 5 turns per conversation)
  • Assess response quality across clarity, usefulness, and accuracy
  • Provide structured feedback and comparative evaluations
  • Submit conversation transcripts and evaluation results


Requirements:

  • Business owner or strong understanding of small business operations
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Ability to follow structured evaluation guidelines
  • Comfortable interacting with AI tools


What you'll work on:

  • Create engaging visual content for marketing
  • Help answer and evaluate situations related to day-to-day operations and customer interactions
  • Conduct market research and contribute ideas in your area of expertise
  • Work with data to support analysis and financial planning
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated responses for small business use cases
  • Use tools and input files such as spreadsheets, PDFs, and images as part of your workflow


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work at the forefront of AI applications in accounting and finance.
  • Fully remote and flexible work environment.
  • Opportunity to collaborate on high-impact projects with global reach.


Offer Details:

  • Project-based with defined number of evaluation tasks
  • Each task includes multi-chatbot comparison and final assessment
  • Duration: 10 weeks.

title: Executive Assistant to Chief Executive Officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executive Assistant to Chief Executive Officer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Beige is looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant to work directly with our Founder & CEO across operations, investor relations, communications, partnerships, personal brand, and high-level business execution.

This is not a traditional assistant position. You will operate as an extension of the CEO and help manage the fast-moving day-to-day environment of a rapidly growing media technology startup.

If you're someone who thrives in high-performance environments, loves organization, thinks three steps ahead, and enjoys solving problems before they happen, we want to hear from you.

About Beige

Beige is an AI-powered media technology platform transforming how content is booked, produced, managed, and delivered at scale.

Through Beige.app, businesses, brands, creators, events, families, and enterprises can seamlessly access content production, media services, creative talent, and technology-driven workflows through a modern, intelligent platform.

We have facilitated thousands of productions and work with startups, major brands, Fortune 500 companies, athletes, creators, celebrities, and high-profile individuals across the United States and internationally. We're building much more than a service company — we're building infrastructure for the future of content.

As Beige scales aggressively, we're building a team obsessed with speed, ownership, execution, innovation, and growth.

Location & Schedule
  • Location: Remote (International / Global Talent)
  • Schedule: Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM PST
  • Note: Operational flexibility outside standard hours when necessary is a strong plus, as startup environments move quickly.
Compensation
  • Contract Rate: Starting at $1,000/month plus performance-based milestones and bonuses. Significant long-term growth opportunities are available for exceptional track-record execution.
What You'll Be Doing
  • Managing the CEO’s calendar, meetings, travel, scheduling, reminders, and priorities.
  • Acting as a gatekeeper and organizer for daily communication and inbound opportunities.
  • Following up on leads, partnerships, investors, advisors, clients, and strategic relationships.
  • Supporting investor relations efforts, fundraising outreach, and executive communications.
  • Helping manage aspects of the CEO’s personal brand, public presence, and social media activity.
  • Drafting emails, presentations, summaries, reports, meeting notes, and business communications.
  • Helping organize and execute projects across multiple departments while tracking deadlines.
  • Coordinating with team members, vendors, partners, and external stakeholders.
  • Turning conversations into action items and ensuring execution actually happens.
  • Assisting with research projects and identifying business opportunities.
  • Acting as an extension of the CEO during meetings and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
Who We're Looking For Required Qualifications:
  • Elite English Proficiency: 10/10 fluent written and spoken English with exceptional professional communication skills.
  • Previous experience directly supporting a Founder, CEO, Executive, or startup leadership team.
  • Strong organizational, project management, and execution skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision and high autonomy.
  • Extremely proactive mindset—you naturally identify and solve problems before they escalate.
  • Strong executive presence, professional judgment, and absolute discretion.
  • High emotional intelligence; comfortable communicating with high-profile individuals and personalities.
  • High adaptability and a calm demeanor when priorities shift quickly in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred / Major Plus:
  • Deep experience within media, content production, technology, entertainment, creator economy, or startup ecosystems.
  • Prior exposure to investor relations, fundraising workflows, or capital raises.
  • Basic graphic design experience (Canva, Adobe, Figma) for creating presentations and marketing assets.
  • Social media management or personal brand building experience.
  • CRM fluency (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, etc.).
  • Advanced proficiency using AI tools (ChatGPT, automation platforms) and modern productivity suites (Google Workspace, Slack, Asana, Notion).
Core Behavioral Expectations:

To succeed in this role, you must thrive on high-speed execution, welcome rapidly shifting priorities, and actively prefer dynamic problem-solving over highly repetitive, predictable administrative tasks.

How to Apply

We are moving fast to fill this position. If you are ready to operate at an elite executive level, please submit:

  • Your Resume
  • A short introduction video (2–3 minutes) detailing:
  • Your specific experience supporting founders, CEOs, or fast-growing startups.
  • Why you are a perfect fit for the culture at Beige.
  • Your favorite productivity and AI tools that you currently use to optimize your workflow.

title: Analista Engenharia de Dados Sênior | Holding
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista Engenharia de Dados Sênior | Holding em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar como Analista Engenheiro de Dados Sênior , dando suporte as áreas de negócio, com propriedade e paixão em cada processo.


Venha fazer parte do time e transformar conosco!


Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Documentar e comunicar os processos de dados e soluções implementadas;
  • Desenvolver pipelines de dados automatizados para coletar, transformar e carregar dados de diferentes fontes;
  • Manter e oferecer suporte aos sistemas de dados existentes, garantindo a integridade e disponibilidade dos dados;
  • Realizar testes, avaliações e ajustes contínuos para otimizar a eficiência, desempenho e segurança dos sistemas de dados;
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e cientistas de dados para criar soluções de análise e visualização de dados personalizadas;
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de armazenamento e processamento de dados usando a GCP, garantindo a escalabilidade e o desempenho.


Requisitos e qualificações

É necessário que você tenha:


  • Perfil proativo;
  • Inglês intermediário técnico;
  • Perfil proativo e com autonomia;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe;
  • Bom raciocínio lógico, perfil analítico;
  • Boa organização, comprometimento com prazos;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal (oratória e escrita);
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de pipelines de dados;
  • Experiência de no mínimo 3 anos na área de Engenharia de Dados;
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de Nuvem como: AWS, GCP e Azure;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Conhecimento avançado em linguagens de programação: Proficiência em SQL, Python e/ou R;
  • Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação e/ou cursos correlatos


Será um diferencial caso você tiver:

  • Conhecimento profundo em tecnologias de armazenamento de dados como BigQuery, Cloud Storage, e Cloud SQL.


Informações adicionais


Modelo de contratação: CLT


Nós oferecemos:

  • Parceria com Zenklub - descontos em sessões de terapias;
  • Parceria com Instituições de ensino - descontos em cursos;
  • Plano de Saúde com coparticipação;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Totalpass.

title: System Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para System Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Systems Engineer II


*Please Read*

Duration: This is expected to be a 12 month engagement with extensions

Location: Remote

Notice Period: Cannot be longer than 2 weeks

Pay: 17.40/hr to 21.13/hr USD or $2,784 to $3,380 USD per month


Systems Engineer II


Must Haves:

• 5+ years of experience managing and developing core infrastructure

• 5+ years of experience with VMware vSphere and Horizon, Windows and Linux servers, and server hardware

• Strong PowerShell experience automating installs, modifying registry and files, and hardening Windows environments including Windows 11 and Server 2019 and 2022

• Experience with cloud services, SSO and MFA tools such as Okta, Microsoft Authenticator, and Duo

• Proficient in managing and troubleshooting secure Windows environments including Active Directory and Azure AD

• Experience with Ansible

• Strong IT operations and engineering background with solid communication and project execution skills


Day to Day:

You will assess, design, and maintain enterprise systems and infrastructure while troubleshooting issues and driving improvements. Responsibilities include automating processes with PowerShell and Terraform, managing server and application environments, supporting system upgrades and migrations, and ensuring performance and availability across IT systems. You will partner with vendors and internal teams, manage change processes, remediate vulnerabilities, and support compliance efforts while serving as an escalation point and mentoring team members.

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Retention Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?


About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.


What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Support Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you looking to work for an innovative and exciting company from Silicon Valley or New York, 100% remotely?


We are looking for multi-skilled candidates with excellent interpersonal and technical skills for the position of Technical Support Specialist .


The ideal candidate will focus on customer success and data fluency , troubleshooting technical issues related to Snowflake, APIs, and large-scale data delivery , rather than traditional IT or desktop support. You will work cross-functionally with Account Managers, Data Fulfillment teams, and Data Engineers to investigate technical issues , document findings clearly, and keep customers proactively informed throughout the resolution process.

This role offers the opportunity to directly impact customer satisfaction and operational excellence , working closely with both technical and customer-facing teams in a dynamic, data-driven company .


The salary range is $1,800 USD to $2,400 USD per month , depending on the candidate's experience and seniority.


Responsibilities:


-Provide front-line technical support for customer issues related to:

  • Data delivery and ingestion .
  • API integrations and troubleshooting.
  • Account and data management .

-Investigate and troubleshoot technical issues , reproducing customer errors when possible, focusing on root cause analysis .

-Validate large datasets, identifying inconsistencies or errors through SQL queries.

-Proactively communicate updates and resolution progress to customers in a clear, professional manner .

-Collaborate with data quality, engineering, and product teams to improve processes, tools, and product stability .

-Maintain accurate case records to measure and improve CSAT , response times, and resolution times.

-Identify recurring themes and translate them into repeatable, scalable solutions .

-Ensure adherence to SLAs while driving timely resolutions.


Requirements:
  • Fluent in English YOU MUST BE ABLE TO HAVE A FLUENT PROFESSIONAL CONVERSATION IN ENGLISH.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field, OR equivalent practical experience in data troubleshooting, support, and integration .
  • 2-4 years of experience in technical support, data operations, or customer experience roles .
  • SQL querying in Snowflake (filtering, joins, sampling for validation).
  • API troubleshooting (REST, error codes, authentication, Postman usage ).
  • Familiarity with bulk data delivery (SFTP, AWS S3, CSV/JSON/XML handling).
  • Data validation and troubleshooting by comparing datasets to detect inconsistencies.
  • Understanding of data ingestion flows (data movement into CRMs, data warehouses, or BI tools).
  • Strong communication skills (written and verbal), able to translate technical issues into customer-friendly updates .
  • Ownership mindset , taking accountability and driving issues through to resolution.
  • Highly collaborative and proactive , with a strong focus on problem-solving and continuous improvement .
